name: Jumia Technologies AG
summary: Jumia Technologies AG operates an e-commerce platform in West Africa, North Africa, East and South Africa, Europe, the United Arab Emirates, and internationally. The company's platform consists of marketplace that connects sellers with customers; logistics service, which enables the shipment and delivery of packages from sellers to consumers; and payment service with its network of licensed payment service providers and other partners, which facilitates transactions to participants active on the company's platform in selected markets under the Jumia name.
